## What is this?

Toxic Mobs is a realy stupid mod that makes Minecraft mobs toxic in the funniest way possible.

When a mob dies, kills a player, or even just spots you, it sends ridiculous rage messages in the chat using your actual username.

Mobs can now send toxic, salty, absurd, or straight‑up stupid chat messages whenever they die, kill a player, or notice someone approaching.

All messages automatically include the player’s name, making every insult feel personal… and hilarious.

## - Death Reactions -
When a mob dies, it blames lag, hacks, reach, or your “skill issue”.

## - Kill Reactions -
If a mob kills a player, it flexes, mocks, and celebrates like it just won a tournament.

## - Sight Reactions -
Some mobs trash‑talk you the moment they see you coming.

## - Player Name Integration -
Messages automatically include the player’s username:
“<player> you stupid cheater!!”,
“<player> no way that was legit”,
“<player> you only win with hacks”, etc.

## - Fully Configurable -
Add your own messages

Adjust frequency


<details>
<summary>Show config file</summary>

```
[messages]
	#set to true if you want to see the mob's name in chat
	display_mob_name = true
    
	#the chance to get text for each entry in the list in interval [0, 1]
	death_message_chance = 0.15
    
	#used at mob death
	death_message = [
    "<player> you stupid cheater!!",
    "<player> no way that was legit",
    "<player> you only win with hacks",
    "<player> you’re carried by your ping",
    "<player> ratio + no skill"
    ]
    
	#the chance to get text for each entry in the list in interval [0, 1]
	kill_message_chance = 0.30
    
	#used when a mob kills a player
	kill_message = ["<player> bro died to a default mob",
    "<player> uninstall pls", "<player> I’m clipping that",
    "<player> get good before coming back",
    "<player> even my grandma PvPs better"
    ]
    
	#the chance to get text for each entry in the list in interval [0, 1]
	target_message_chance = 2.0E-4
    
	#used when a mob is targeting an entity (every frame so this should be realy low)
	target_message = [
    "<player> oh no not you again",
    "<player> pls go bully someone else",
    "<player> you farming me for XP? cringe",
    "<player> I can smell the skill issue",
    "<player> I’m literally just vibing leave me alone"
    ]

```

</details>

## Why use this mod?
- Makes combat way funnier
- Perfect for multiplayer chaos
- Great for trolling friends
- Recreates the energy of toxic PvP servers
- Turns every death into a comedy moment


Hope you have fun with my silly idea!
